olivia (FE): Quick q — frontend teams want to call our internal gRPC model-router directly from browsers. Is grpc-web + Envoy the official path or should we offer a lightweight JSON bridge?
kevin (Platform): I'd avoid exposing raw gRPC. grpc-web + envoy works but it's another proxy layer. Tradeoffs: streaming support vs CORS/auth headaches.
maria (API): A JSON adapter at the gateway (proto <-> json) would let backend keep typed protos while web gets fetchable endpoints. Simpler for some clients.
jamal (SRE): Warning: adapter = extra CPU and a critical path. Also changes how we count tokens/quotas (double-marshalling risk).
olivia (FE): Frontend teams want auto-generated clients and small bundles. grpc-web gives typed stubs. Also better for streaming UX.
kevin (Platform): grpc-web can be brittle w/our auth/cookies and some browsers. Streaming needs special handling (SSE or websocket bridge). Envoy helps but config is non-trivial.
maria (API): Proposal: support both, behind per-route mode flags. Primary: internal gRPC. Public: a "proto-bridge" at edge -> supports mode=json or mode=grpc-web. Route-configurable.
jamal (SRE): +1 but enforce per-mode quotas and throttles. JSON tends to be chatty (small requests). We should emit telemetry fields: request_size, proto_decode_ms, token_estimate.
olivia (FE): UX for rollouts — canary by header/cookie, fallback to JSON if grpc-web fails. Frontends need graceful degradation not hard errors.
kevin (Platform): Implementation notes: Envoy has grpc-web support natively. For JSON bridge we'd use protojson (google) or generated mappers. Need descriptor management for runtime mapping.
maria (API): For safety, the bridge should accept pinned descriptor sets per-service-version. That avoids silent breakages when we change protos. Versioned descriptor blob in config.
jamal (SRE): Observability checklist: counters for grpc_calls, json_calls, fallback_count, decode_errors, plus spans for translation_latency. Hook alert when translation_latency > 50ms p95.
olivia (FE): Can I spike this? I'll prototype a tiny bridge behind a feature flag and route 2 internal apps. Will provide sample TS clients.
kevin (Platform): Go for it. Keep it stateless and autoscalable. Ensure bridge passes through auth headers for audit logs and ties into quotas. Add a circuit-breaker fallback.
maria (API): Also add an eval harness to compare end-to-end latency and token accounting across modes. We must not double-count embedding tokens if bridge touches request body.
jamal (SRE): Test long-lived streams under load. If streaming matters -> prefer grpc-web. Otherwise JSON wins for simplicity and debugging.
olivia (FE): I'll draft a short RFC with config examples and sample client code snippets (grpc-web vs fetch + protojson). Will ping @kevin (Platform) and @maria (API) when ready.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/bridge-spike -> staging (hash: abc123) :rocket:
kevin (Platform): Nice. Once staging metrics look good we'll plan canary rollout and add dashboard panels for latency, errors, and token-cost.
